subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Bashful
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e. **'Intoverted'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most **appropriate synonym** for the given word **"Bashful" **is **1) Introverted.**
 
• **Bashful** means shy, timid, or hesitant in social situations. (शर्मीला/लज्जाशील)
 
• It refers to a person who is easily embarrassed or self-conscious and tends to avoid attention or interaction with others.
 
• **Introverted **refers to a person who is more focused on their inner thoughts and feelings, prefers solitude or small social gatherings, and may find social interactions draining. (आंतरवाणी)

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Introverted'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Explanation of the meaning of the options:
 
 
• **Expanded:** Expanded means increased in size, extent, or scope. It does not convey the same meaning as bashful. (विस्तृत)
 
• **Experimented:** Experimented refers to the act of trying something new or engaging in a process of trial and error to discover or learn something.(प्रयोग किया)
 
• **Concussed: **Concussed refers to a person who has suffered a concussion, which is a mild traumatic brain injury caused by a blow to the head.(सिर की चोट)
 
 

39:T9ed,

The correct answer is **'Option 2'**
